module: FFI declarations (ffi.cdef) of the C++ debug drawing functions (BNG_DBG_DRAW_*): sphere, cylinder, line, text, square prism, filled triangle and batch versions. Only runs if ffi is available. A modder does not normally call these symbols directly: use the debugDrawer API instead.
notes: The file defines no Lua function or field: only an ffi.cdef.
Colors are passed as a packed unsigned integer (packedCol).
Also declares the typedef Vector3 {float x, y, z}.
